The discussion centered on analyzing a frequency chart and addressing data discrepancies. Initially, [me] provided an analysis based on device samples, noting that while it would be closer to totals than the model, it wouldn't perfectly match due to the sampling method.

Later, [p1] questioned significant deviations observed when comparing staging and production datasets. [p1] suggested a methodology where the target number of unique users (uniques) is used as the final figure, and proportions derived from the sample are applied to this target unique count, focusing on the deviation at the unique user level.

[me] agreed to implement this revised calculation method, which was subsequently deployed to staging. Both parties confirmed that the results looked acceptable.
decisions: The frequency chart analysis will be adjusted to use the target number of uniques as the base figure for calculations.
